query: INSERT INTO fantatt.identity_aliases (alias_id, player_id, raw_alias, normalized_alias, evidence, confidence, status) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7) ON CONFLICT (player_id, normalized_alias) DO UPDATE SET raw_alias = EXCLUDED.raw_alias, evidence = EXCLUDED.evidence, confidence = EXCLUDED.confidence, status = EXCLUDED.status, resolved_at = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.status = 'RESOLVED' THEN now() ELSE NULL END RETURNING alias_id
